summary: Acquire Electron-compatible single-instance ownership and forward secondary-instance data.

target.notes: Use an OS inter-process lock plus a channel capable of delivering argv/working-directory/additionalData semantics to the primary instance.

caveats: A process-local Mutex object is insufficient unless it is named/OS-visible and paired with secondary-instance data delivery.
additionalData must be serializable according to the compatibility contract.

tests.name: first instance
tests.expected_behavior: true when no other compatible instance holds the lock

tests.name: second instance
tests.expected_behavior: false in a secondary instance and the primary can receive equivalent second-instance data
